meta.title: 新手修容跟练｜阴影、高光区域 一次性搞懂
meta.title_en: Beginner Contouring Follow-Along — Shadow & Highlight Zones in One Go

scenes.title_cn: 开场：有折叠没折叠、有修容没修容，差…
scenes.title_en: Opening: folded vs flat, contoured vs not—…
sentences: 新手化妆最怕的就是修容，怕画了脸脏。
Beginners fear contouring the most, afraid of a dirty face.
fear contouring（怕修容）
脸脏是因为画错了位置，在本不该有阴影结构的地方上阴影。
Dirtiness comes from shadowing where no shadow structure exists.
wrong placement（画错位置）
第二个是控制不好用量，下手太重。
Second is a heavy hand with too much product.
heavy hand（下手太重）
scenes.speak: Beginners fear contouring the most, afraid of a dirty face. Dirtiness comes from shadowing where no shadow structure exists. Second is a heavy hand with too much product.

scenes.title_cn: 为什么必须修容：刚上完粉底液的脸还没…
scenes.title_en: Why contour at all: a freshly founded face…
scenes.context: 粉底抹平立体度需还原。
sentences: 粉底液会覆盖掉一些本身有的阴影结构，变成一张大白脸。
Foundation covers natural shadows into one flat pale face.
flat pale face（大白脸）
第一是把被粉底液抚平的立体度给它还原回去。
First, restore the dimension foundation flattened.
restore dimension（还原立体度）
第二是调整比例、修饰五官和脸形。
Second, adjust ratios and refine features and face shape.
adjust ratios（调整比例）
scenes.speak: Foundation covers natural shadows into one flat pale face. First, restore the dimension foundation flattened. Second, adjust ratios and refine features and face shape.

scenes.title_cn: 修鼻子：鼻骨轮廓不是直线条，是有凹有…
scenes.title_en: The nose: the nose bone isn't straight—it …
sentences: 鼻骨不是直线条，画两条直直的阴影线会显脏显假。
The nose bone isn't straight—two straight shadow lines look dirty and fake.
straight lines look fake（直线显假）
鼻头上面是个八，下面是个U，山根是个倒着的八。
The tip is an inverted eight above and a U below; the bridge root is flipped.
shape language（形状语言）
鼻尖的U弧度越大鼻子越长，弧度越平鼻子越短。
A bigger U curve lengthens the nose; flatter shortens it.
adjust the U（调U弧度）
scenes.speak: The nose bone isn't straight—two straight shadow lines look dirty and fake. The tip is an inverted eight above and a U below; the bridge root is flipped. A bigger U curve lengthens the nose; flatter shortens it.

scenes.title_cn: 修眼部：之前那条眼妆公式教过在眼睛上…
scenes.title_en: The eyes: the eye-makeup formula taught a …
scenes.context: 平行四边形眼窝+浅色塑造。
sentences: 从眼头到眉毛的三分之一，到眉尾，再到卧蚕最低点，回到眼头。
From the inner corner to one-third of the brow, to the tail, to the aegyo-sal's lowest point, and back.
the parallelogram（平行四边形）
可以用眼影盘里的浅色小肿色，塑造眼部轮廓。
Use a light matte eyeshadow shade to sculpt the socket.
sculpt the socket（塑造轮廓）
让眼睛深邃又立体，画个淡淡眼妆就很好看。
Deep and dimensional eyes make a soft eye look shine.
deep and dimensional（深邃立体）
scenes.speak: From the inner corner to one-third of the brow, to the tail, to the aegyo-sal's lowest point, and back. Use a light matte eyeshadow shade to sculpt the socket. Deep and dimensional eyes make a soft eye look shine.

scenes.title_cn: 修面颊：脸宽脸方或颧骨比较高就一定要…
scenes.title_en: The cheeks: wide, square faces or high che…
scenes.context: 找转折区域而非直接上阴影。
sentences: 把修容上在正面就一定会显脏，上在侧面又没什么效果。
Contour on the front dirties; on the side it does nothing.
the wrong zones（错误区域）
关键点在于找到正侧面的转折区域，让明暗关系过渡自然。
The key is the transition zone where light and dark pass naturally.
transition zone（转折区域）
这两条线中间的区域，决定了视觉上我们脸的宽窄。
The area between the lines determines visual face width.
determines width（决定宽窄）
scenes.speak: Contour on the front dirties; on the side it does nothing. The key is the transition zone where light and dark pass naturally. The area between the lines determines visual face width.

scenes.title_cn: 提亮逻辑：实在控制不好阴影，咱们靠提…
scenes.title_en: The highlight logic: if you can't control …
sentences: 如果阴影不变只让高光更亮，变立体的同时就不会显脏。
Keep shadows still and only brighten highlights—dimension without dirt.
highlight instead（提亮代替）
用少量阴影通过加强高光，也能达到不错的修容效果。
A little shadow plus boosted highlight gives a solid contour.
solid contour（不错的修容）
修容就像学自行车，一直担心摔跤不敢尝试，你永远都是一张大白脸。
Contouring is like learning a bike—fear of falling keeps you a flat pale face.
learn like a bike（像学骑车）
scenes.speak: Keep shadows still and only brighten highlights—dimension without dirt. A little shadow plus boosted highlight gives a solid contour. Contouring is like learning a bike—fear of falling keeps you a flat pale face.

practice: Shadowing the wrong places or a heavy hand.
Tip is an eight and U; root is a flipped eight.
Sculpt the socket with light matte eyeshadow.
Find the light-dark transition zone, not the front face.
Keep shadows still and only boost highlights.
pitfalls: Put shadow where no shadow exists.
不该有阴影的地方上阴影会显脏。
Contour the front face for width.
面颊修容要找转折区域。
Boost highlights instead of darkening shadows.
阴影控制不好就靠提亮。
Keep a natural fold—too flat looks fake.
shifts: 用 shape language（形状语言）、transition zone（转折区域）、shadow structure（阴影结构）
用 inverted eight（倒八）、the U curve（U弧度）、bridge root（山根）
用 restore dimension（还原立体度）、sculpt the socket（塑造眼窝）、shade-narrowing blush（收缩色腮红）
